svg.title: ARTales Brand Snapshot v0.2
svg.desc: Self-contained structured review board. PNG is the canonical human preview. Not runtime and not a token source.
svg.text: REVIEW-ONLY / NOT RUNTIME / NOT TOKEN SOURCE
v0.2 adds reliable PNG preview, exports, usage guidance and registry pointer
PNG = canonical human preview · SVG = structured source · JSON = provenance
DOCUMENTED PALETTE VALUES — NOT ACTIVE TOKENS
Authoritative geometry remains in the individual locked master files.
Shown here without modifying or deriving new master assets.
primary-light: main use on paper/light · primary-dark: main use on dark
monochrome-light: dark backgrounds only · monochrome variants are fallback/secondary
Exports are derived delivery assets, not authoritative geometry.
Broader UI tokenization is not done yet.
Source route: Libre Baskerville verified source package
Current wordmark master: outline SVG · runtime does not require the font file
The font is not exclusive; the protected brand layer is the ARTales composition,
• micro symbol for tiny favicon/app-icon contexts
• runtime icons only for browser/PWA contexts
• stretching lockups or recoloring masters ad hoc
• treating this review board as a token source
• micro symbol in normal-size symbol contexts
• assuming current site CSS is tokenized
09 · Future token candidates — proposal only, not implemented
NON-RUNTIME PROPOSAL · NO TOKEN FILES OR CSS CHANGES
